text_en: One day, as he was teaching the people in the temple and telling the good news, the chief priests and the scribes came with the elders
text_cn: 有一天，耶稣在圣殿里教训百姓，及宣讲喜讯的时候，司祭长、经师及长老前来，

text_en: and said to him, “Tell us, by what authority are you doing these things? Who is it who gave you this authority? ”
text_cn: 对他说道：“请你告诉我们：你凭什么权柄作这些事？或者是谁给了你这权柄？”

text_en: He answered them, “I will also ask you a question, and you tell me:
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“我也要问你们一句话，你们告诉我：

text_en: Did the baptism of John come from heaven, or was it of human origin? ”
text_cn: 若翰的洗礼是从天上来的，还是从人来的呢？”

text_en: They discussed it with one another, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven, ’ he will say, ‘Why did you not believe him? ’
text_cn: 他们心里忖度说：“如果我们说：是从天上来的，他必要说：你们为什么不信他？

text_en: But if we say, ‘Of human origin, ’ all the people will stone us; for they are convinced that John was a prophet. ”
text_cn: 如果我们说：是从人来的，众百姓必要用石头砸死我们，因为他们都确信若翰是先知。”

text_en: So they answered that they did not know where it came from.
text_cn: 于是他们回答说：“不知道是从那里来的。”

text_en: Then Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things. ”
text_cn: 耶稣也给他们说：“我也不告诉你们：我凭什么权柄作这些事。”

text_en: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard, and leased it to tenants, and went to another country for a long time.
text_cn: 耶稣对百姓设了这个比喻：“有一个人培植了一个葡萄园，把它租给园户，就往远方去，为时很久。

text_en: When the season came, he sent a slave to the tenants in order that they might give him his share of the produce of the vineyard; but the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
text_cn: 到了时节，他便打发一个仆人去园户那里，为叫他们把园中应纳的果实交给他。园户却打了他，放他空手回去。

text_en: Next he sent another slave; that one also they beat and insulted and sent away empty-handed.
text_cn: 园主又打发了另一个仆人去，他们也把那人打了，并加以侮辱，放他空手回去。

text_en: And he sent still a third; this one also they wounded and threw out.
text_cn: 园主又打发第三个去，连这一个，他们也打伤，把他赶了出去。

text_en: Then the owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son; perhaps they will respect him. ’
text_cn: 葡萄园的主人说：我要怎样办呢？我要打发我的爱子去，或许他们会敬重他。

text_en: But when the tenants saw him, they discussed it among themselves and said, ‘This is the heir; let us kill him so that the inheritance may be ours. ’
text_cn: 谁知园户一看见他，便彼此商议说：这是承继人，我们要杀掉他，好让产业归于我们。

text_en: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
text_cn: 于是他们把他推到葡萄园外杀了。那么，葡萄园的主人要怎样处置他们呢？

text_en: He will come and destroy those tenants and give the vineyard to others. ” When they heard this, they said, “Heaven forbid! ”
text_cn: 他必要来，除灭这些园户，把葡萄园租给别人。”众人一听这话，就说：“千万不要这样！”

text_en: But he looked at them and said, “What then does this text mean: ‘The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?
text_cn: 耶稣注视他们说：“那么，经上所载：‘匠人弃而不用的石头，反而成了屋角的基石，’这句话是什么意思？

text_en: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces; and it will crush anyone on whom it falls. ”
text_cn: 凡跌在这石头上的，必被撞碎；这石头落在谁身上，必要把他压碎。”

text_en: When the scribes and chief priests realized that he had told this parable against them, they wanted to lay hands on him at that very hour, but they feared the people.
text_cn: 经师及司祭长在那时刻就想下手逮捕耶稣，但是害怕百姓。他们明白这个比喻是暗指他们说的。

text_en: So they watched him and sent spies who pretended to be honest, in order to trap him by what he said, so as to hand him over to the jurisdiction and authority of the governor.
text_cn: 于是他们窥察耶稣，派遣奸细，假装义人，要抓住他的语病，好把他交付于总督的司法权下。

text_en: So they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are right in what you say and teach, and you show deference to no one, but teach the way of God in accordance with truth.
text_cn: 他们就诘问他说：“师傅，我们知道你说话施教，都正直无私；又不看情面，但按真理教授天主的道路。

text_en: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to the emperor, or not? ”
text_cn: 敢问：我们给凯撒纳丁税，可以不可以？”

text_en: But he perceived their craftiness and said to them,
text_cn: 耶稣觉察出他们的诡计，便对他们说：

text_en: “Show me a denarius. Whose head and whose title does it bear? ” They said, “The emperor’s. ”
text_cn: “你们拿一个‘德纳’来给我看！这‘德纳’上有谁的肖像，有谁的字号？”他们说：“凯撒的。”

text_en: He said to them, “Then give to the emperor the things that are the emperor’s, and to God the things that are God’s. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“那么，凯撒的，就应归还凯撒；天主的，就应归还天主。”

text_en: And they were not able in the presence of the people to trap him by what he said; and being amazed by his answer, they became silent.
text_cn: 他们在民众面前，不能抓到他的语病，且惊奇他的应对，遂噤口不言。

text_en: Some Sadducees, those who say there is no resurrection, came to him
text_cn: 否认复活的撒杜塞人中，有几个前来问耶稣说：

text_en: and asked him a question, “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies, leaving a wife but no children, the man shall marry the widow and raise up children for his brother.
text_cn: “师傅，梅瑟给我们写道：如果一个人的哥哥死了，撇下妻子而没有子嗣，他的弟弟就应娶他的妻子，给他哥哥立嗣。

text_en: Now there were seven brothers; the first married, and died childless;
text_cn: 曾有兄弟七人，第一个娶了妻子，没有子嗣就死了。

text_en: then the second
text_cn: 第二个，

text_en: and the third married her, and so in the same way all seven died childless.
text_cn: 及第三个都娶过她为妻子。七个人都是如此：没有留下子嗣就死了。

text_en: Finally the woman also died.
text_cn: 末后，连那妇人也死了。

text_en: In the resurrection, therefore, whose wife will the woman be? For the seven had married her. ”
text_cn: 那么，在复活的时候，这妇人是他们哪一个的妻子？因为他们七个人都娶过她为妻。”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “Those who belong to this age marry and are given in marriage;
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“今世之子也娶也嫁；

text_en: but those who are considered worthy of a place in that age and in the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.
text_cn: 但那堪得来世，及堪当由死者中复活的人，他们也不娶，也不嫁；

text_en: Indeed they cannot die anymore, because they are like angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
text_cn: 甚至他们也不能再死，因为他们相似天使；他们既是复活之子，也就是天主之子。

text_en: And the fact that the dead are raised Moses himself showed, in the story about the bush, where he speaks of the Lord as the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
text_cn: 至论死者复活，梅瑟已在《荆棘篇》中指明了：他称上主为亚巴郎的天主，依撒格的天主及雅各伯的天主。

text_en: Now he is God not of the dead, but of the living; for to him all of them are alive. ”
text_cn: 他不是死人的，而是活人的天主：所有的人为他都是生活的。”

text_en: Then some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you have spoken well. ”
text_cn: 有几个经师应声说：“师傅，你说的好。”

text_en: For they no longer dared to ask him another question.
text_cn: 从此，他们再不敢质问他什么了。

text_en: Then he said to them, “How can they say that the Messiah is David’s son?
text_cn: 耶稣问他们说：“人们怎么称默西亚是达味之子呢？

text_en: For David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
text_cn: 达味自己曾在圣咏集上说：‘上主对吾主说：你坐在我的右边，

text_en: until I make your enemies your footstool. ”’
text_cn: 等我使你的仇敌变作你脚下的踏板。’

text_en: David thus calls him Lord; so how can he be his son? ”
text_cn: 达味既称他为主，他怎样又是达味之子呢？”

text_en: In the hearing of all the people he said to the disciples,
text_cn: 众百姓正听的时候，耶稣对他的门徒说：

text_en: “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk around in long robes, and love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces, and to have the best seats in the synagogues and places of honor at banquets.
text_cn: “你们应慎防经师！他们喜欢穿长袍游行，喜爱街市上的致敬，会堂里的高位，筵席上的首座。

text_en: They devour widows’ houses and for the sake of appearance say long prayers. They will receive the greater condemnation. ”
text_cn: 他们吞没寡妇们的家产，而又以长久的祈祷作掩饰：这些人必要遭受更重的处罚。”
